description: Find EU public-contract winners from official TED award notices published since a date. Use this for discovery or company win history; awards_get_contract retrieves a known notice and tenders_list_deadline_changes tracks submission deadlines. All filters narrow together; CPV prefixes within cpv are alternatives. Normalized winner is a name prefix, winner_id an exact identifier. Returns awards with winners, buyer, value, CPV, dates, lots, notice URL and SHA-256 proof, plus count/has_more/next_cursor/feed. Reuse next_cursor with the same filters to page or poll stored awards; about 45 days are retained. Check feed.checked_at and publication coverage; results are stored observations, not a live TED search. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

country.description: Buyer country, 3-letter ISO code as TED uses, e.g. DEU, FRA, POL

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2 to 8 digits, e.g. 72 for IT services; up to 5, comma-separated

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; a followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. a0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

since.description: Awards published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago; about 45 days are kept); e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

winner.description: Winner name prefix, e.g. Mennica Polska; at least 3 normalized letters/digits; case/accent/punctuation-insensitive, normalized text truncated to 200 characters

winner_id.description: Winner official identifier, e.g. PL1234567890; exact normalized match, at least 3 letters/digits; punctuation ignored and normalized key truncated to 64 characters

name: awards_list_contracts
title: List EU contract awards
